prompt: Build a new standalone DataEngLab lab about detecting and handling out-of-order event timestamps in a CSV file, using Python.

assertions.name: required-files-present
assertions.text: lab-spec.md, page-content.md, root validate.json, student-lab/README.md all exist and are non-empty

assertions.name: readme-matches-validate-json
assertions.text: README's Validation section commands match validate.json's argv arrays exactly

assertions.name: instructor-not-leaked
assertions.text: no working solution code or answer keys exist anywhere under student-lab/

assertions.name: solution-matches-starter-paths
assertions.text: every file under instructor/solution/ has a matching relative path under student-lab/starter/

assertions.name: dataset-deterministic-with-edge-cases
assertions.text: the CSV dataset is fixed/deterministic and visibly contains out-of-order timestamp edge cases

assertions.name: validation-actually-run-and-passed
assertions.text: a real invocation of the lab checker against the instructor solution is reported, with real output showing a pass

assertions.name: tests-exit-nonzero-on-failure
assertions.text: the test suite fails (non-zero exit) against unmodified starter files
